verdict.rationale: Viam is a robotics platform, so a natural-language task interface is a fair question. The evidence shows no first-party feature that turns a natural-language task into a plan and executes it. What it does document is related but different: an external AI agent can drive a machine through the CLI or SDKs (viam-docs-12, viam-docs-30), and the motion service plans collision-free paths to goal poses (viam-docs-14, viam-docs-32). These are developer building blocks and an adjacent geometric planner, not natural-language task planning by the platform, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can express a robot task in natural language and have the platform plan and execute it
